summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-5C43 filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting that on October 9, 2026, Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC and sponsor Barclays Capital Real Estate Inc. entered an underwriting agreement with eight underwriters for the sale of CMBS certificates. Public certificates total $883,116,000 aggregate initial principal; private certificates total $106,370,532, sold under Section 4(a)(2) exemption. Closing is scheduled October 29, 2025 (as stated in the filing, though later than the agreement date). This is a routine CMBS securitization issuance, not a special situation.
